lines.en: I walk slowly, and the fog follows.
Each step dims the light a little.

lines.zh: 树皮一样的身体，沙沙响。
lines.en: A body like bark, rustling as it moves.
I cross the dead leaves in silence.
I go around that lamp.
I hug the wall and move through shadow.
This night is long enough for a long walk.
My steps are counted out.
The wind passes through me like a hollow shell.
Step by step, I close the distance.
I stand in the dark, unmoving.
Fog gathers at my feet.
I listen to the wick burning.

lines.zh: 这一身根须，还缠着旧土。
lines.en: These roots still hold old soil.
Darkness is my food.

lines.zh: 两个晚上前，你听见我了吗？
lines.en: Two nights ago, did you hear me?
My eyes shine in the light.
The brighter the light, the more awake I am.
I wait for the fog to thicken.
That tree grows like me.

lines.zh: 我记着你走过的每条路。
lines.en: I remember every path you walk.

lines.zh: 墙角的影子里，有另一个我。
lines.en: There is another me in the corner shadow.

lines.zh: 我轻轻敲了敲自己的胸口。
lines.en: I tap my own chest.
Roots spread slowly under the soil.
A little longer, and it is time.
You hold up a lamp. I see it.
Between us lies a stretch of dark.
You dare not turn around. Right?
I know the light you carry.
Your breathing is loud.

lines.zh: 我站在你的灯照不到处。
lines.en: I stand where your lamp does not reach.
If you would look, look properly.

lines.zh: 这身皮，你数得清年轮吗？
lines.en: Can you count the rings in this hide?
A little brighter and I will leave.
I step back, and the fog recedes.
That blow scattered my shape.
I give a muffled sound.
The dark is mending me.
Again. I am still here.
Darkness doesn't make me feel pain.
The light still burns. I can still stand.
You can't scatter what the fog holds together.
What would you feed me?
I want only what glows.
Raise it higher.
Your hand shakes badly.
Set it down and go. Do not look back.
It is light I want, not food.
I look at it, and it dims.
Keep it. You will need it.
You collided and the fog broke.

lines.zh: 你会看见浓雾，然后是我。
lines.en: You'll see fog, then me.
My shell is harder than wood.
You back off; I come forward.
We met, and your lamp swayed.
Ramming me accomplishes nothing.
I push you toward the dark.

lines.zh: 我的根须缠住了你的脚。
lines.en: My roots have caught your feet.
That strength will not break the night.
So close in the fog, the light will die.
There is no such thing.
That is not needed here.
I know only the dark.
Roots touch beneath the soil.
We do not grow together.
Between our kind, there is only silence.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有一声回应。
lines.en: I hear one answer far off.
It is drawn to light too.
We go our separate ways.
Such meetings come once a year.
I will bury it.
This carries your scent.
In my hand it goes cold.
I set it under the roots.
Whatever it was, it belongs to the dark.
I have no use for this.
I press it into the soil.
It sprouts in my hand.
I do not mean to return it.
The lamp. I see it.
The light on you is too conspicuous.
I am coming your way.
The fog has closed the road.
You will not sleep that night.
The light drew me.
I have held this breath a long while.
I will snuff that flame.
Roots are already under your feet.
I count only to three.
Do not raise the lamp. It will not help.
Did you notice the wind stopped?
From this second, run.
I have chosen you.
Here already.
You should not have lit that lamp.
I follow that small light.
Your lamp does not pierce it.
Ten paces behind you.
I do not run, so I do not tire.
I miss none of your prints.
A shadow goes around the other side.
What you hear is the wind.

lines.zh: 门口的根，已经长过来了。
lines.en: The roots at the door have grown across.
Your hands shake. The lamp will die.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，光就弱一分。
lines.en: Every step I take, the light weakens.
You have circled twice already.
Keep going and you reach the end.
The shadows all follow me.

lines.zh: 你数一数，是不是少了一盏灯。
lines.en: Count your lamps. Is one missing?
I have been beside you all along.
Turn around and there I am.
I lay a hand over your lamp.
Roots lash up from below.
That swipe came with soil.
A root has cinched your shoulder.

lines.zh: 雾气一下子贴住你的脸。
lines.en: The fog presses onto your face.
I take a measure of your light.
You did not hear me come.
That one came slowly.
My fingertips are like dead branches.
The smell of blood is faint.
Back further and you are against the tree.
I merely touched you.
That was only a warning.
At night I am faster than by day.
There is no moon tonight.
I rise from between the roots.
There is too much light here.
I count more than ten lamps.
Something stirs underground.

lines.zh: 我离开苍白的花园很久了。
lines.en: I left the pale garden long ago.
This place is emptier than I expected.
I let my shadows out.
The wind stopped. That is my signal.

lines.zh: 我的胸口，长着别人的心。
lines.en: Another's heart grows in my chest.
People in every direction. Good.
I drive my roots into the soil.
Two nights ago, I was already calling.
The thickness tonight is just right.
I look up. No stars.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把光找出来。
lines.en: I go step by step, hunting the light.
Do not light every lamp.
The dark is very near here.
I have arrived.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，散了一地枯枝。
lines.en: I fall from height and scatter like dead branches.
Water pours into this hollow shell.
The blast tears the fog wide open.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过了我的胸口。
lines.en: Something passed through my chest.

lines.zh: 这道咒把我和黑暗隔开了。
lines.en: This hex cuts me off from the dark.
Without light, I wither by degrees.
Lightning lights everything, and I recoil.

lines.zh: 下面没有土，根须抓不住。
lines.en: No soil below. My roots find nothing.
